faq.a: Bakri is associated with the Arabic form بَكْرِي, whose core sense is bakri; of bakr (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Bakri?
faq.a: Bakri is associated with Arabic. Bakri is Arabic بَكْرِيّ (Bakrī), the relative form of بَكْر (Bakr), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form بَكْرِي is Arabic.
Bakri can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Bakri should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Bakrī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Bakri mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Bakri is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، بکر سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Bakri mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Bakri is rendered بکری and carries the sense بکری، منسوب به بکر.
A romanized syllable approximation is bak-ri. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Bakri?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Bakri, bakri. Script forms are بَكْرِي, بکري, بکری, बकरी.

faq.q: Is Bakri a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
